directive: Use BUSINESS.md as the current EIR soul draft, but do not present this as operator-approved or investible until validation gates clear.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: dispatch gate instruction]; see the PR's POM record
snapshot: CivicState is a buildable civic-letter product, but remains watchlist until paid demand and delivery prove out.
one_liner: CivicState is buildable, but remains watchlist until paid demand and delivery prove out.

methods: Read existing planning and product specification files.
Inspected code paths for product reality versus roadmap claims.
Labeled all external market and financial claims as assumptions because network access was unavailable.

planningMethod: Bottom-up EIR diligence: preserve true repo signal, separate evidence from assumptions, reconcile financial model from pricing tiers, and turn roadmap into validation work.

customer.definition: US resident with a specific civic frustration who wants help researching, drafting, routing, and sending constituent communications [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
customer.validationStatus: Unvalidated; no workspace evidence of paying users, live traffic, revenue, or official response data [evidence: .planning/existing-state.md and absence of production metrics]
customer.firstCohort: 100 paid submissions [assumption: minimum directional validation cohort]

market.method: Bottom-up issue-event model because no external market research was available.

businessModel.marginFloor: 40% net margin floor after fees [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md and MASTER_PLAN.md]
businessModel.baseVariableCost: $0.90 per paid submission [assumption: no vendor invoices in workspace]
businessModel.launchConstraint: Paid acquisition should remain deferred until conversion is proven [assumption: low-ticket economics]

sensitivityTests: $3 variable cost creates $54,000 third-year variable cost [assumption]
financialModel.reconciliation: Each revenue line is paid submissions multiplied by blended price; each variable-cost line is paid submissions multiplied by $0.90 [assumption].

alternatives: Manual email or phone calls [assumption: substitute workflow]
competition.positioning: Research-backed, cited, paid, tracked constituent letters for individuals rather than petitions, enterprise advocacy software, or legal advice.

alternatives: Manual direct outreach by citizens [assumption: substitute workflow]
Existing civic messaging or petition platforms [assumption: category substitute]
Legal document services for users who misclassify the job as legal help [assumption: adjacent substitute]

holes: No paid demand evidence in the workspace [evidence: no production metrics file and .planning/existing-state.md]
Low blended price leaves little room for paid acquisition [assumption: $13 modeled price]
Official email deliverability may fail despite product quality [assumption: deliverability risk]
Legal-adjacent content may require more review than one operator can handle [assumption: operating risk]
mitigations: Run a concierge beta before scaling automation [assumption: validation method]
Keep paid acquisition deferred until conversion is proven [assumption: economic guardrail]
Use domain warming, bounce monitoring, and opt-out suppression [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]
Keep citation verification and human-review flags mandatory [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts]
residualRisks: Users may value the result but not pay repeatedly [assumption]
Government servers may silently filter messages [assumption]
The project identity mismatch may make the dossier misleading [evidence: dispatch project id versus repo product files]

strategy.posture: Watchlist research asset until validation proves a business case [evidence: registry note]
strategy.focus: Validate payment conversion, delivery, citation quality, and operator workload before adding speculative features.
strategy.moat: Potential official-directory, citation-library, and public-campaign archive assets; weak until real submission volume accumulates [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]

goToMarket.firstWedge: Concierge beta plus narrow issue pages [assumption: EIR GTM model]
goToMarket.deferred: Paid ads, organization/API sales, certified mail, fax, multilingual support, and coalition features stay deferred [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md and .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Monitor flagged submissions, delivery failures, treasury reconciliation, and official-directory maintenance [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md and apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts]
operatorWorkflow.decisionNeeded: Operator must decide whether brooks-history should pitch CivicState as a business [evidence: registry note]

constraints: Workspace-only; no network research was used [evidence: dispatch instruction]
External market claims are assumptions [evidence: dispatch instruction]
Registry note says watchlist/personal-research, not near-term investible BOS [evidence: registry note]
Legal-adjacent product; do not invent legal conclusions [evidence: dispatch sensitivity instruction]
Current product uses app-specific auth, billing, and delivery rails [evidence: code inspection]
metrics: Delivery success or inbox-placement proxy [assumption: deliverability metric]
Citation verification failure rate [assumption: quality metric]
Manual review minutes per day [assumption: operator metric]
Refund and chargeback rate [assumption: trust metric]

aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Researcher may only cite supplied search results and strips unverified citations [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts]
aiWorkGovernance.moderationPolicy: Threats are blocked, defamation-risk content is flagged, and moderation is audit-logged [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts and .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]
aiWorkGovernance.disclosurePolicy: AI disclosure and not-legal-advice posture are required in planning [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]

unknowns: Whether users will pay at the modeled prices [assumption]
Whether official lookup coverage is sufficient locally [assumption]
Whether deliverability clears the planned gate [assumption]
Whether legal review permits the launch posture [assumption]
